name: Sarah Znideric
headline: Partnerships & Alliances @ Pattern®
about:
As Global VP of Partnerships at market-leading eCommerce SaaS solution Linnworks, I bring over 20 years of commercial leadership experience across eCommerce consulting, digital marketing, SaaS, and high-growth technology startups.

My career to date has been defined by building and scaling high-performing global teams and driving impactful go-to-market strategies across partnerships, sales, customer success, and marketing. I’m passionate about helping businesses adapt to the evolving needs of their customers online and delivering sustainable growth through strong partner ecosystems.

With over a decade of executive board-level experience in digital marketing consultancies and VC-backed startups, I’ve developed a strong track record of forging strategic alliances, growing revenue, and enabling innovation at scale.

In addition to my professional work, I’m proud to mentor university students studying Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Business, supporting the next generation of leaders in the digital economy.
… more

experiences.description:
Linnworks is the leading eCommerce automation platform that connects and manages commerce operations, powering businesses to sell wherever their customers are and capture every revenue opportunity. As Amazon and eBay's largest European commerce partner, Linnworks enables businesses to manage their multi-channel inventory, orders and fulfilment from a single dashboard and provides deep insights across sales channels and operations. 

In my role I lead Linnworks' global alliances and commercial partnerships team, owning our relationships with the world's leading ecommerce channels including Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google, Mirakl, Meta and TikTok. As part of the global SLT I work across core business functions including Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success to ensure our partnerships drive shared commercial success and support customer growth and retention.

Good Growth are one of the fastest growing e-commerce consultancy businesses in the UK, leading customer insight, CRO and growth strategy for some of the largest retail brands including Kraft-Heinz, Pets at Home, WHSmith, Fat Face, Diageo and boohoo.com. 

As a board director I held overall responsibility for customer success and client strategy for Good Growth’s global client base. Working closely with data and insights leads, my global team of expert consultants and digital marketers delivered projects and managed strategic engagements that raised our company NPS scores to an average 10/10 for two consecutive years.

Head of Client Services & Strategy at Organic, an award winning digital performance and search consultancy based in Soho, London and Southernhay, Exeter. In my role I worked with some of the UK's leading brands in retail, finance, insurance, professional services and FMCG to lead strategic decision making and deliver high performance campaigns. With oversight of client management teams and digital marketing services, I worked closely with clients including Direct Line Group, Argos, IRIS, Natwest and Real Good Food Plc to ensure smooth service delivery alongside managing the ongoing client satisfaction and results against set KPIs.

Overall management of the business including leadership of teams across Organic's London and Exeter offices. In my role I was responsible for the creation and delivery of the business plan, reporting progress and performance to the board and management of the P&L.

Leading product growth activity and retailer partnerships for Fantasy Shopper, a leading VC-funded fashion tech start-up based and winner of the Amazon Start Up Challenge in SF in 2012. Responsible for the strategy and implementation of all global growth activities including advertising, social media, SEM, PR, email marketing, promotions, sponsorship and brand management. In addition held responsibility for all partnership relationships and opportunities with fashion retailers and affiliates from the UK and USA. 

Also led the marketing and community management of TBH, an independent mobile app for both iPhone and Android. Backed by Accel and NEA, the app was featured by Apple in its “New & Noteworthy” section. TBH was one of the fastest growing social networking apps in 2013.

A marketing-led graphic and website design agency based in Devon. As a board Director of the company I was involved in all key business decisions as well as heading up the Client Success and Sales teams. I had responsibility for the ongoing satisfaction of all DNA's existing clients including British Ceramic Tile, Ascari Race Resort, Brand-Rex, Princess Yachts International, WKD, Subway and the London Trocadero.

Responsible for a combination of new business and account management across a range of clients including Stovax, Original Style, The Edge, Inspiring Holidays and Dartmouth TIC.

Key responsibilities included:
• Management of multimedia and website projects
• Responsible for new business generation through attending regular networking events, pitches and writing speculative proposals
• Management of marketing activity and client events
• Attending client briefings, delivering initial concepts and maintaining excellent communication throughout project duration

Responsible for all revenue generation for defense and commercial aviation titles such as Military Training and Simulation News (MT&SN) and Cabin Safety Update. Represented the business at the Worlds leading aviation events including the Paris and Southampton Air Shows, ITEC in Europe and I/ITSEC in the USA.
